title: Preparation of leukocytes by differential lysis of erythrocytes
author: Mesut Karataş
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcv2iw8e

steps.title: Pellet blood cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 10 mL of EDTA blood at 1500 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C to pellet all cells.

steps.title: Collect and store plasma
steps.instruction: Remove the plasma into a clean container and freeze it.

steps.title: Restore blood volume
steps.instruction: Restore the original blood volume using 0.9% saline and transfer the resulting blood suspension into a 50 mL conical centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Lyse erythrocytes
steps.instruction: Add 40 mL of cold lysis buffer to the suspension and incubate on ice, mixing occasionally, until the erythrocytes are lysed (suspension remains red but becomes transparent).

substeps.instruction: Incubation should take approximately 5 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Wash leukocyte pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the leukocyte pellet in 5 mL of cold lysis buffer.

steps.title: Dilute and centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Dilute the cell suspension to 50 mL using cold 0.9% saline, mix, and centrifuge at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend leukocytes in saline
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the leukocyte pellet in 10 mL of 0.9% saline, ensuring an even suspension without vigorous mixing to avoid cell disruption.

steps.title: Prepare cell aliquots
steps.instruction: Divide the cell suspension into two equal aliquots using two 10 mL conical centrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Final pelleting and drying
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the aliquots at 1500 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Dry the walls of the centrifuge tube with a tissue.

steps.title: Store samples
steps.instruction: Store the leukocyte pellets and plasma at -20 °C or -80 °C.
